subject.title: fix(agents): thinking-enabled Anthropic sessions fail with "Invalid signature" after tool loops

question: Should OpenClaw adopt current-turn-only signed-thinking replay as the default for all thinking-enabled native Anthropic sessions?
rationale: The patch is symmetric, tested, and live-proven, but it intentionally changes historical context and cache semantics for every existing thinking-enabled Anthropic session; code evidence cannot decide that product tradeoff alone.

options.title: Adopt current-turn replay
options.body: Land the symmetric policy and accept completed-turn reasoning omission as the default resilience tradeoff.

options.title: Preserve full history
options.body: Keep full same-model replay and pursue narrower malformed-signature detection, persistence repair, and provider-rejection recovery.

recommendation.title: Adopt current-turn replay
recommendation.body: Land the symmetric policy and accept completed-turn reasoning omission as the default resilience tradeoff.
